topics.title: Introduction to Mobile Phones, Computer & Internet Concepts

subtopics.content: Acronyms/terminologies, phone bands, phone types, accessories, menus, service codes, basic computer components, and web browsing platforms
subtopics.objective: Define mobile phone terminologies (GSM, CDMA, SMS, MMS, BSI)[cite: 373]; classify single/quad bands, straight/flip/slide phone types, accessories, and menu structures[cite: 373]; identify computer hardware/software components[cite: 373, 374]; navigate web access platforms (WAP, GPRS, 3G, Wi-Fi) for downloading/uploading[cite: 374].

topics.title: Essential Components, Maintenance, and Repairs of Mobile Phones

subtopics.content: Block diagrams (power, memory, radio), hardware components (CPU, SIM socket, buzzer), electronic components, preventive/corrective maintenance, repair tools, workshop safety, and common hardware/software faults
subtopics.objective: Understand phone structural block diagrams and functions of hardware/software components[cite: 374]; test electronic components (resistors, capacitors, transistors, ICs)[cite: 374]; execute preventive and corrective maintenance (cleaning, soldering, re-balling)[cite: 374]; use hardware tools (precision sets, multimeters, oscilloscopes) and software tools (unlocking, flashing software)[cite: 374, 375]; apply workshop safety rules and first aid[cite: 375]; diagnose hardware faults (damaged screens, charging ports) and software codes/errors[cite: 375].

subtopics.content: Disassembling/assembling, PCB circuit reading, voltage testing, signal tracing, SMD/BGA troubleshooting, flashing/unlocking, workshop capital/location, and business management
subtopics.objective: Execute disassembling, assembling, and troubleshooting of displays, speakers, and charging jacks[cite: 375]; read PCB layouts and schematic diagrams[cite: 375]; perform voltage level testing and signal tracing[cite: 376]; troubleshoot SMD and BGA components[cite: 376]; execute phone flashing and security unlocking[cite: 376]; establish a repair workshop considering capital, equipment, location, costing, and return on investment[cite: 376].
